versions.changelog:
Initial release: Efficient tool for retrieving structured public data from Xiaohongshu.

- Provides keyword search, note details, note comments, and creator post list as JSON (up to 10,000 items per request)
- Requires GUAIKEI_API_TOKEN for use; works only with public, non-private data
- Node.js CLI, no login or deployment required
- Includes routing, input prompts, anti-patterns, and robust error/edge case handling
- Well-documented scenarios, environment setup, and usage best practices
